raw_response:
I farm the way I know will keep the land productive without taking on too much risk. On my 8 mu, I will keep most of the land in the wheat-maize rotation because that is the main system I already know well, it fits our local conditions in Quzhou County, and with some family labor going off-farm I need crops that are familiar and manageable. I will keep a smaller piece in cotton because cotton still gives me some cash income and spreads risk, but I will not put too much land into it because it needs more field care. Since I have well irrigation, I will use it to protect yield at key stages instead of relying only on rainfall. For seed, I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps yield and stability. I will use moderate fertilizer, not the highest possible rate, because I want steady production and I do not want to waste money. I will do rotary tillage for wheat and maize because it is practical for me, and I will use plough tillage for cotton so the soil is looser for establishment. I will spray pesticides only as much as needed to keep labor and cost under control while protecting the crop.
